title: HbA2 Leuven and Its Impact on HbA1c Results
brief_summary: The study is designed to demonstrate HbA2 Leuven mutation and to asssess its impact on routine HbA1c measurements.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Family history of HbA2 Leuven mutation.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Any condition inhibiting simple blood withdrawal.
